description: SLDC Parking Account is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by South Lakeland District Council. This dataset contains an annual summary of the car parking account from South Lakeland District Council. Please note; figures published in April are interim figures and will be updated later in the year once the final accounts have been audited. These include a breakdown of the income and expenditure on the parking account. Coverage: South Lakeland District Council. The portal files it under the publisher South Lakeland District Council. It offers 7 resource(s) in CSV, HTML. The portal shows 2026-07-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
